name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.03 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
